rows.notes: Replaces the earlier reported-tier 210,000 t Li2CO3 figure. SQM Q1-2025 release (6-K, 27 May 2025): 'working to reach a total capacity of 240,000 metric tons of lithium carbonate and 100,000 metric tons of lithium hydroxide' in Chile; Industrial Info (30 May 2025) says carbonate 240,000 t 'by next year' (2026) and hydroxide 100,000 t 'by the end of this year' (2025). capacity_norm 328,000 t LCE = 240,000 (Li2CO3) + 100,000 x 0.88 (LiOH monohydrate, D-102). These are Chile-wide targets for the SQM chemical plants (Salar del Carmen carbonate and hydroxide plants near Antofagasta; the release does not break out Coya Sur); stated targets, NOT confirmed installed capacity. installed_capacity left null. FY2025 results (27 Feb 2026): 'operating at full capacity to meet our customer commitments' (S3). Reported-tier: Nova Andino Litio sold ~233,100 t LCE in 2025 (S4; sales not plant production, includes Salar de Atacama volumes and China-made volumes are excluded per release), so actual Chile output is ~233 kt LCE vs the 328 kt LCE target. Search summaries give conflicting hydroxide plans (30,000 t in 2022 -> 40,000 t; 100,000 t by end-2025). The SQM 2025 Form 20-F (sqm-20251231.htm, filed 2026-04-22, sec.gov accession 0000909037-26-000023) exceeds the 10 MB fetch limit and could not be read; its Item 4 capacity table should supersede this row. sqm-ynv.com redirect from sqm.com seen and not followed. Capacity of Salar del Carmen alone vs total Chile not separable from the sources opened. Nova Andino Litio is the SQM-Codelco venture (SC008 notes).

Albemarle FY2025 Form 10-K Item 2 lists La Negra (Chile) among active plants: 'Production of technical and battery-grade lithium carbonate' (S6); 10-K says 'During 2025, the Company's manufacturing plants operated at approximately 81% capacity, in the aggregate' (S5; company-wide, not La Negra-specific). The 10-K does not give per-plant tonnage; 85,000 t Li2CO3 capacity remains from SC008 company-page evidence (page undated). No plant-level 2025 output found (Albemarle reports attributable mine production: Salar de Atacama 14 kt Li metal in 2025 per 10-K, not plant output).

Albemarle FY2025 10-K Item 2 footnote: 'both of the constructed trains of the Kemerton plant will be in care and maintenance' (S7) - primary-source confirmation that the plant is idle (project_state paused). Capacity (2 x 25,000 t LiOH built; Trains 3-4 stopped) unchanged from SC008 (reported tier). Contributes 0 operating capacity as of Feb 2026.

STATUS CHANGED from operational to under_construction (ramp-up/commissioning): Wesfarmers FY26 results (27 Aug 2026, page 11): first product and sales of LiOH achieved in FY2026, ramp-up affected by intermittent odour issues, mitigation measures started late FY26, recovery 'anticipated to remain below the targeted design rate during financial year 2027', and 'A portion of costs incurred during the ramp-up phase will continue to be capitalised until commercial production is achieved' (i.e. commercial production NOT yet reached). Production rates expected to accelerate through 2H FY27; offtake qualification to finish 2H FY27. Wesfarmers publishes NO hydroxide tonnage (only spodumene: WesCEF share 209 kt FY26; 151 kt sold; remainder to refinery/inventory), so 2025 and FY26 output = not disclosed (null). Nameplate 50,000 t/y LiOH (25,000 t attributable to SQM). capacity_ref_year: SQM Q2-2025 6-K says 18-month ramp to nameplate 'by the end of 2026' (S11) -> 2026; Covalent's own release (S12) says 18 months from Aug 2025 (= early 2027); SC008 used 2027. The lead may keep status operational if 'first product' is the definition; I treated the brief's 'commercial production reached' literally.
